scope: Broadened comparison of explicit DXF 3D geometry, ACIS carriers, AcDs DWG storage, open-source reader/writers, and FreeCAD consumer boundaries

method.kind: static review of current primary DXF documentation, public project source/documentation, and live issue/PR pages
method.sourcePinning: GitHub main/master documentation and source pages were read on 2026-10-15 but not pinned to immutable commit IDs unless their URLs identify an issue or pull request. Recheck mutable sources before external qualification.
method.evidenceRule: Peer issue reports and proposed changes are leads/counterexamples, not normative schema or independent support qualification. No reported reproduction was executed in this review.

capabilityLayers.name: opaque_payload_retention
capabilityLayers.proves: Bytes and chunk boundaries remain associated with the correct record through a defined same-profile transfer.
capabilityLayers.doesNotProve: Typed structure, valid geometry, placement, units, history graph, editability, display, or consumer acceptance.

capabilityLayers.name: typed_structure_and_reference_closure
capabilityLayers.proves: Versioned entities/objects, owners, payload carriers, handles, and reference joins are structurally decoded and remapped.
capabilityLayers.doesNotProve: Kernel validity, mass properties, topology equivalence, or display.

capabilityLayers.name: explicit_geometry_semantics
capabilityLayers.proves: Coordinates, connectivity, flags, transforms, and units for explicit faces/meshes/curves match a defined source manifest.

capabilityLayers.name: kernel_geometry_semantics
capabilityLayers.proves: A named independent geometry kernel reads valid bodies and matches source-authored bounds, units, volume/area, topology, and applicable placement/history measures.
capabilityLayers.doesNotProve: Whole-document DXF/DWG references or arbitrary consumer support.

capabilityLayers.name: named_consumer_acceptance
capabilityLayers.proves: A pinned application/platform/importer/converter configuration accepts the target profile and exposes the expected content.
capabilityLayers.doesNotProve: Other application routes, importer modes, operating systems, or unsupported representations.

sources.evidence: 3DFACE stores WCS corners and invisible-edge flags. MESH stores subdivision/version data, vertex and face-index lists, edges/creases, and per-subentity overrides. OCS/WCS treatment varies by entity family. Polyface face records use ordered indices and signed values for invisible edges.
sources.assessment: Published entity contracts. Useful for structural/explicit-geometry tests; not a native writer/readback or kernel oracle.
sources.planUse: Test connectivity, orientation, invisible edges, crease/override records, WCS versus OCS, nested INSERT transforms, units, and malformed/count-bounded lists; do not accept matching entity/vertex totals as a semantic pass.

sources.evidence: 3DSOLID has a modeler format version, proprietary payload strings/chunks, and a separate soft-owner history reference. ACAD_PROXY_ENTITY has separate binary graphics and entity-data areas, class identity, format version and possible object IDs.
sources.assessment: Published DXF group-code contracts; version/profile compatibility and payload semantics require additional evidence.
sources.planUse: Keep ACIS modeler payloads, proxy display graphics, and custom entity data as separate payload/reference lanes. Validate bounds and reference closure; opaque retention must not be called typed/semantic support.

sources.evidence: Open issue #1411 reports an AC1032 generated REGION whose 5,489-byte SAB is lost in a dxf2dwg/dwg2dxf trip while the entity remains, and an unavailable real R2018 file with 88 empty-body regions. Current NEWS says AcDsPrototype_1b is not yet fully decoded and newer ACIS SAB extraction is brute-force; current source includes an AcDs section decoder/schema path.
sources.assessment: The issue's reported repro and confidential sample were not run or independently inspected here. NEWS/source establish a peer implementation status, not normative DWG semantics. The apparent difference between source section support and incomplete body/schema handling is important: recognizing a section is not complete object/payload decoding.
sources.planUse: AC1027+ AcDs container, DataStorage records, prototype-owner joins, per-body SAB mapping and handle lifecycle must be proven before an inline-only entity writer is considered complete. No silent success on entity count when has_ds_data indicates a missing body.

sources.evidence: Open issue #1195 reports 252 3DSOLID objects omitted from one DXF and 51 3DSOLID plus 3 REGION omitted from another, including blocks consisting entirely of solids; the author says LibreDWG census confirmed the source records. The issue asks for warning/notification or opaque passthrough. PR #1240 is open and linked to the issue, and depends on ACDS/ACIS schema refactor #1174; a distinct PR #1150 also proposes ACIS payload writing.
sources.assessment: Issue examples are customer drawings that were not attached or reproduced here. The open PRs are proposals, not merged runtime capability or format authority.
sources.planUse: Add block-definition-only and nested INSERT solid cases to loss/disposition tests; census by source handle, owning block, payload source (inline versus AcDs), raw/typed route, and emitted/refused outcome. Compare peer proposals only after pinning executable revisions.

sources.evidence: ezdxf can inspect/export ACIS carrier text and generate some ACIS DXF entities, but documents no ACIS rendering/general 3D drawing support and describes ACIS support as basic. IxMilia/dxf lists several ACIS/proxy classes while warning that certain entity writers, including 3DSOLID, may not be AutoCAD accepted and listing MESH and SURFACE gaps.
sources.assessment: Mutable current docs/project declarations and one maintainer discussion; no runtime was executed. API/entity registration and carrier inspection do not establish geometry interpretation.
sources.planUse: Use ezdxf for tag/carry inspection and generated transport vectors, not as the ACIS kernel/display oracle. Treat peer writer declarations as candidate syntax only; require independent parser readback and named-target application acceptance.

sources.evidence: Current mutable C++ importer source has a generic TopoDS_Shape-to-Part::Feature path with a 3DFACE example comment; this alone does not establish all 3DFACE/MESH/polyface forms enter or survive that path. FreeCAD documentation repo was archived 2026-04-01; its Draft DXF guide distinguishes C++ and legacy importers, lists legacy 3D-face support, and says standard import cannot read ACIS blobs. DWG guides describe converter-to-DXF followed by the standard importer and separately identify CAD Exchanger as the 3D DWG route. The current wrapper delegates conversion to external tools.
sources.assessment: Current source is mutable and not pinned to a commit; the archived docs can lag source. No native FreeCAD process was run. Neither source snippet nor old support table qualifies the present build/configuration.
sources.planUse: Keep native Linux and Windows FreeCAD checks but report exact app/build, platform, C++/legacy importer, converter, settings and file hashes. Separate standard 2D/explicit-entity compatibility from optional commercial CAD Exchanger 3D import; do not use stock FreeCAD as the ACIS B-rep oracle or count its expected ACIS rejection against converter fidelity.

revisedOrder: Fast per-handle disposition and payload-presence census; cover modelspace, BLOCKS, nested INSERTs and OBJECTS; preserve the existing 2D adapter behavior.
Version-profiled explicit 3D entity map and generated controls: WCS/OCS, units, topology/index order, invisible-edge and crease data, transforms and malformed bounds.
Pre-AC1027 inline SAT/SAB container/profile and history-link path, then AC1027+ AcDsDataStorage decode, owner/prototype/history graph closure and SAB association; no entity-only shortcut.
Exact version-aware DXF/DWG write/transfer and independently parsed readback; reject unsupported/lossy profiles before publishing output.
Native consumer matrix and independent kernel semantic measurements only at composed checkpoints; distinguish stock FreeCAD from optional CAD Exchanger route.
minimumNoSilentLossAssertions: source and emitted counts are compared by type and owning block, not only document totals
each ACIS entity with an external AcDs body has a resolved nonempty body or conversion refuses
every payload has an explicit retained, translated, refused, or unsupported-with-diagnostic disposition
class counts, handles, owner/history refs and payload associations describe only the final admitted emitted set
a failed conversion does not publish a stale/partial destination
implementationReadiness.fastValidation: Use locally-authored in-memory/generated controls and structural parser assertions after each slice; existing tracked fixtures only. Run composed FreeCAD/Linux+Windows and independent kernel gates once per completed capability/profile, not per field edit.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No new third-party DWG/DXF fixtures. Keep generated files and reports in disposable build/tmp storage; existing repository or locally authored fixtures remain eligible under existing fixture policy.
